author: Ryan Daws
description:
Multi-agent AI systems require strict AWS Cedar policies to prevent unchecked privilege escalation during automated delegation. Software engineers deploying multi-agent AI architectures face a distinct authorisation vulnerability when autonomous agents delegate tasks through multi-hop chains.
